timeline.label: Filed FY2025 20-F showing record revenue near €32.7B and strong operating cash flow
Filed FY2024 20-F; revenue recovery continued post-2023 trough
Filed FY2023 20-F during semiconductor down-cycle with weaker cash generation
Expanded export restrictions on advanced lithography to China remained a structural demand risk

industry.structure: Oligopoly at leading edge: ASML is the sole EUV supplier; DUV competes with Nikon and Canon at mature nodes. High R&D and install-base service contracts create switching costs.
industry.share_shift: Leading-edge logic and memory fabs concentrate orders with ASML for EUV; China domestic alternatives lag on EUV but policy drives localization efforts.
industry.trend: AI and advanced-node investment support High-NA EUV ramps; memory recovery and export-control policy remain swing factors for order cadence.
